about: Sound packs shared by Elsewhere and Somewhere. Each pack is a pack.json plus FLAC files (48 kHz stereo); see src/SoundLibrary.h. Add a pack here and both apps list it.

packs.name: Starter Sounds
packs.description: Drum kits (recorded and synthesised) and instruments played across the pads
packs.credit: Drums: Karoryfer Lecolds (CC0) and Elsewhere. Instruments: VSCO 2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (CC0).

packs.name: Organic Sounds
packs.description: Strings (ensembles, solo, tremolo, pizzicato), woodwinds, brass, upright piano, pipe organ, harp, mallets, bells and textures, from VSCO 2 Community Edition (CC0)
packs.credit: VSCO 2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (CC0); upright piano and organ sampled by Simon Dalzell (Ivy Audio)
